content.short: Clearstar is a risk curator operating DeFi lending vaults on Hyperliquid and Monad.
content.description: Clearstar Labs curates lending vaults on Hyperliquid and Monad, defining the risk parameters depositors are exposed to. Curators carry meaningful responsibility in isolated lending markets, since the protocol enforces the rules but the curator chooses them, and a poorly set liquidation threshold is not something code will catch.
